slides.title: Overview - Fighter Sends
slides.html:
1. Send messages using what's ordered in your unit, eg. Matrix or GeoChat. Messages go to COMMAND, RECON, BLUFOR or COMMON depending on your content.
  2. Send your Markers to HQ role for CP's interpretation.
  3. If your unit has so ordered, Send recon observations also to the OBSERVATIONS Feed

slides.title: Overview - Fighter Gets
slides.html:
1. Receive the CP-produced RECON Feed to get what we know of the AO

  2. Receive Mission PLAN Feeds for marching routes, patrol routes, geofence alerts...

  3. Receive the BLUFOR Feed with eg. approach routes to friendly positions

  4. Monitor the Messaging tool of choice in your unit (Geochat, Matrix or others).

    \

slides.title: How To?
slides.html:
1. The following Use RECON Feed guide will instruct you how to send & receive markers.
  2. The Use Geochat for comms guide will instruct you how to use TAK's Geochat for messaging.
  3. The Use Matrix Element for comms guide will instruct you how to use an app external to TAK, Matrix Element, for messaging. It is the recommended alternative to TAK's Geochat.
